name: post-uploads-logo-and-returns-object-id
description: POST /cmis uploads src/main/resources/mulesoft-logo.jpg to /okm:root/ as pic<currentTimeMillis>.jpg (image/jpg, cmis:document, versioning NONE) and returns the created ObjectId as JSON. The Mule IT asserts the body starts with {"id":"/okm:root/pic.

source.reference: document-integration-using-the-cmis-connector/src/test/java/org/mule/examples/DocumentIntegrationUsingTheCmisConnectorIT.java#httpGetToFlowUrlSentMessage (POST, startsWith {"id":"/okm:root/pic); call attributes from src/main/app/cmis-document-integration.xml cmis:create-document-by-path-from-content; file from the Groovy 'Load file' script
